command:
set -e
repo=/home/ma-user/work/s9/repository/ascend-s9-operators
echo 'CLOUD_SYNC_BEFORE'
git -C "$repo" branch --show-current
git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD
if test -n "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"; then
  echo 'Tracked cloud changes detected; refusing to overwrite.' >&2
  git -C "$repo" status --short
  exit 2
fi
git -C "$repo" fetch origin main
git -C "$repo" merge --ff-only origin/main
echo 'CLOUD_SYNC_AFTER'
git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD
git -C "$repo" status --short
